{{Quote|Sir! Message's origin is determined to be in the vicinity of Arda planets One, Two and Three!''"<br />"''Prepare to destroy all three, if necessary!|An [[Imperial Navy Trooper/Legends|Imperial Navy Trooper]], to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="ALAWL" />}}
The '''Arda system''', originally known as the '''Ethain system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Feldwes system/Legends|Feldwes]] and [[Kalishik system/Legends|Kalishik systems]], and another hyperlane linked it to the [[Capella system/Legends|Capella system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ethain]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Arda I]], [[Arda II]] and [[Arda III]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==History==
{{Quote|If you'll protect our fighters from the advantage you've given the Empire&hellip; in payment, we'll attack Vader's fleet&hellip; try to keep them ''off'' your planet&mdash;!''"<br />"''The choice is ''yours'', Exec Temora!''"<br />"''We&hellip; will not be panicked by a ''rumor!'' Why&hellip; Darth Vader may be using ''you''&hellip; to test ''our neutrality&mdash;!''|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a [[Unidentified Rebel pilot 1 (Arda II)|Rebel pilot]], and [[Temora]]|<ref name="ALAWL" />}}
The [[Star system/Legends|star system]], originally known as the Ethain system, was absorbed into [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]] as [[Xim/Legends|he]] [[Xim's Expansionist Period|expanded]] his borders from the [[Kingdom of Cron]], attacking it from the [[Stenos system/Legends|Maldont system]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Capture_of_Eeth_Koth.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Steadfast'' is attacked near the Arda system]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Steadfast (Venator-class)/Legends|''Steadfast'']], was [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|attacked]] near the Arda system, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master was taken hostage by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref><ref name="FF-2014 21">{{FactFile2014|21|21 BBY 3-6|Intrigues in the Outer Rim}}</ref>

The [[Ardan (people)|inhabitants]] of [[Arda II]] tried to remain neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="TEA" /> but openly supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Mag Doum]] discovered a Rebel presence on the world.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|40|Arda II}}</ref> During the [[Stenax Massacres]], Arda II was [[Invasion of Arda II|invaded]] by the [[Stenax]].<ref name="TMS">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
